## 功能富集分析

```{=typst}
#report-intro("按比较组和上下调方向依次展示显著富集条目。图与预览表按校正后 P 值升序排序；无可用结果时明确标注。")
```

```{python}
#| label: pdf-enrichment
#| output: asis
from bioreport.utils.pdf_results import enrichment_chunks, raw_probability_columns
from bioreport.config import display_path
from omics.rna.analysis.enrichment_plotly import parse_gene_ratios
if not comparisons:
    typst_note('比较组表没有有效记录；不生成富集图表。')
for comp in comparisons:
    for direction, label in [('UP','上调'),('DOWN','下调')]:
        path = get_file_path(config, f"{comp}_{direction}.csv", local_base_dir=enrich_base_dir)
        if not path or not os.path.isfile(path):
            typst_note(f"{comp} {label}：未提供富集结果，跳过该方向。预期位置（数据目录内相对路径）：{display_path(enrich_base_dir)}/{comp}_{direction}.csv")
            continue
        frame = pd.read_csv(path)
        required = {'Description','GeneRatio','Count','p.adjust'}
        if required - set(frame.columns):
            raise ValueError(f'Missing enrichment columns: {sorted(required-set(frame.columns))} in {path}')
        cutoff = enrichment_settings.get('p_cutoff',.1)
        filtered = frame[frame['p.adjust'] < cutoff].sort_values('p.adjust',kind='stable')
        if filtered.empty:
            typst_note(f"{comp} {label}：没有校正后 P < {cutoff} 的富集条目。完整输入结果（数据目录内相对路径）：{display_path(path)}")
            continue
        count = pdf_settings.get('enrichment_top_n', 12)
        valid = parse_gene_ratios(filtered['GeneRatio']).notna() & pd.to_numeric(filtered['Count'],errors='coerce').ge(0)
        if not valid.all():
            typst_note(f'{comp} {label}：{int((~valid).sum())} 个满足阈值的条目因 GeneRatio / Count 缺失或无效而不绘图；预览表保留原始记录。')
        chosen = filtered[valid].head(count)
        chosen = chosen.assign(Count=pd.to_numeric(chosen['Count']))
        # Split high label densities instead of shrinking font size.
        for start, chunk in enrichment_chunks(chosen):
            fig, conf = draw_fancy_dotplot(chunk, top_n=None, p_cutoff=None,
                height_num=450, width_num=1000, wrap_width=28)
            fig.update_layout(coloraxis_cmin=float(chosen['p.adjust'].min()), coloraxis_cmax=float(chosen['p.adjust'].max()),
                              meta={**fig.layout.meta,'count_max':int(chosen['Count'].max())})
            databases = sorted({str(v).split(':')[0] for v in chunk.get('ID',[]) if str(v).startswith(('GO:','KEGG:'))})
            category = '/'.join(databases) if databases else '输入结果条目'
            if 'ONTOLOGY' in chunk: category += ' / ' + '/'.join(sorted(chunk['ONTOLOGY'].dropna().unique()))
            show_figure(fig, caption=f"{comp} {label}富集分析（{category}），条目 {start+1}–{start+len(chunk)}。基因比例为输入 GeneRatio；气泡面积对应 Count，颜色对应校正后 P 值。同一方向各分图共用色标和气泡大小比例。")
        typst_note(f"{comp} {label}：{len(filtered)} / {len(frame)} 个条目满足校正后 P < {cutoff}；正文展示前 {len(chosen)} 个。")
        preview(raw_probability_columns(path,frame), path, sort_by='p.adjust', limit=pdf_settings.get('enrichment_rows',10),
            columns=['Description','GeneRatio','Count','p.adjust'])
```
